overall.assessment: Prema navedenoj strukturi, podcast sadrži snažnu kršćansku jezgru: molitvu, pouzdanje u Božje milosrđe, obraćenje, bratsku opomenu i sliku Crkve kao živoga hrama sazdanog na Kristu. Njegova pastoralna namjera da se osuđuje grijeh, a ne osoba, te da se cijene obraćenje i služenje više od popularnosti, uglavnom je usklađena s evanđeoskom logikom; ipak, politički jezik o „anticrkvi”, izjednačavanje političkog ishoda s Božjim djelovanjem i tvrdnja da se crkveni legitimitet „zarađuje plodovima” mogu zamagliti razliku između duhovnog razlučivanja, prosudbe javnih djela i crkvenog autoriteta. Naglasak na plodovima može biti koristan ako znači plodove obraćenja, zajedništva i misije, ali postaje reduktivan ako se legitimitet mjeri uspjehom, dosegom ili vlastitim kriterijima umjesto vjernošću Kristu i crkvenom zajedništvu. Budući da su dostupni samo naslovi blokova i podtema, a ne prijepis, procjena ne može utvrditi kako su političke i crkvene tvrdnje obrazložene ni koliko su nijansirane.
seeds_of_logos: Krunica Božjega milosrđa, litanije, Gospina krunica i molitva za ustrajnost usmjeravaju slušatelje prema Kristovu križu i uskrsnuću; takva pobožnost ima evanđeoski smisao kada vodi pouzdanju u Boga, obraćenju i ljubavi prema bližnjemu.

Slika Crkve kao duhovnog hrama s Kristom kao zaglavnim kamenom odgovara biblijskoj slici zajednice koja je sazidana na Kristu i apostolima; Crkva je zajedništvo živih „kamenova”, a ne samo organizacija ili platforma za pojedinačni utjecaj.

Razlikovanje grijeha od grešnika, poziv na blagost prema osobi i javna isprika zbog vlastitih slabosti mogu poticati poniznost i pomirenje. Kršćansko obraćenje ne znači poricanje grijeha, nego njegovo priznavanje u svjetlu Božjeg oproštenja i obnove dostojanstva čovjeka.

Tvrdnja da je obraćenje nekoliko ljudi vrednije od velikog broja pregleda suprotstavlja se kulturi mjerljivosti i usmjerava pozornost na osobu, a ne na popularnost. To je plodonosno ako se ne pretvori u samopotvrđivanje vlastite skupine, nego ostane povezano sa služenjem i poštovanjem dostojanstva svih.

Molitvene skupine, post i poziv na molitvu u zajedništvu mogu podupirati ustrajnost, solidarnost i zajedničku odgovornost za život Crkve. Socijalni nauk Crkve povezuje vjeru s ljubavlju, brigom za bližnje i djelovanjem za opće dobro, a ne samo s osobnom pobožnošću.
concerns: Suprotstavljanje „Crkve” i „sotonine anticrkve” nosi rizik podjele na moralno čistu vlastitu skupinu i neprijateljski tabor. Duhovna borba protiv zla ne bi se smjela poistovjetiti s demoniziranjem političkih protivnika, drugih kršćanskih zajednica ili ljudi koji se ne slažu; kršćanska opomena treba čuvati istinu, pravednost i dostojanstvo osobe.

Povezivanje pada političkog vođe ili izborne poruke s Božjim djelovanjem može sugerirati providencijalnu sigurnost koju sama struktura podcasta ne dokazuje. Katoličko sudjelovanje u politici jest legitimno i važno, ali prosuđuje se prema istini, dostojanstvu osobe i općem dobru, ne prema tome odgovara li neki izbor željama određene vjerske skupine.

„Legitimitet kroz rezultate” i pitanje „gdje su ti rezultati?” zahtijevaju jasno razgraničenje: vidljivi plodovi obraćenja, zajedništva i misije jesu važni, ali crkveni autoritet ne može se svesti na broj obraćenih, pratitelja, uspjeh inicijative ili osobnu procjenu voditelja. Crkva je duhovni hram povezan s Kristom i apostolskim temeljem, a ne samo projekt čija se vjerodostojnost utvrđuje mjerljivim učinkom.

„Vjera i politika: nema mjesta za dva kraljevstva” može biti zdrava tvrdnja da se vjera ne smije zatvoriti izvan javnog života, ali bi bila problematična ako bi značila poistovjećivanje političke vlasti ili programa s Kraljevstvom Božjim. Crkva sudjeluje u javnom životu radi istine, pravde i općeg dobra; njezin je politički angažman ograničen moralnim načelima i poštovanjem dostojanstva svih.

Molitve zaštite i oslobođenja mogu izraziti pouzdanje u Krista, no njihov se pastoralni učinak ne bi smio predstavljati kao automatska garancija zaštite niti zamijeniti razborito prosuđivanje, sakramentalni život i odgovarajuću pomoć u stvarnim teškoćama. Iz same strukture nije moguće procijeniti kako su te molitve objašnjene ili primijenjene.
overall.theological_context: Efežanima 2,20–22 prikazuje Crkvu kao građevinu na temelju apostola i proroka, s Kristom kao zaglavnim kamenom, dok Lumen gentium Crkvu promatra kao otajstvo zajedništva i Božji narod; taj okvir podupire temu hrama, ali upozorava da se Crkva ne poistovjećuje s jednom političkom stranom ili medijskim projektom. Katekizam, kako ga sažima katolički tekst o političkoj odgovornosti, upozorava da zanemarivanje ranjene ljudske naravi vodi ozbiljnim pogreškama u politici i moralu, pa razlučivanje mora uključiti i vlastite slabosti i društvene strukture. Božje milosrđe u biblijskom i crkvenom nauku istodobno razotkriva grijeh i otvara mogućnost oproštenja, obraćenja i obnove ljudskog dostojanstva; zato blagost prema grešniku ne isključuje istinu, a osuda grijeha ne opravdava ponižavanje osobe.

overall.assessment_en: According to the stated structure, the podcast contains a strong Christian core: prayer, trust in God's mercy, conversion, fraternal correction, and the image of the Church as a living temple built on Christ. Its pastoral intention to condemn sin and not the person, and to value conversion and service more than popularity, is mainly aligned with evangelical logic; nonetheless, political language about the "anti-church", equating a political outcome with God's action, and the claim that ecclesial legitimacy is "earned by fruits" can blur the distinction between spiritual discernment, the judgment of public deeds, and ecclesial authority. An emphasis on fruits can be fruitful if it means the fruits of conversion, communion, and mission, but it becomes reductive if legitimacy is measured by success, reach, or one's own criteria instead of fidelity to Christ and ecclesial communion. Since only the titles of blocks and subtopics are available, and not a transcript, the assessment cannot determine how political and ecclesial claims are substantiated or how nuanced they are.
overall.theological_context_en: Ephesians 2:20–22 presents the Church as a building on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ as the capstone, while Lumen gentium views the Church as a mystery of communion and the People of God; that framework supports the theme of the temple, but warns against identifying the Church with a single political side or media project. The Catechism, as summarized by a Catholic text on political responsibility, warns that neglecting wounded human nature leads to serious errors in politics and morality, so discernment must also include one's own weaknesses and social structures. God's mercy in biblical and Church teaching simultaneously exposes sin and opens the possibility of forgiveness, conversion, and renewal of human dignity; therefore, gentleness toward the sinner does not exclude truth, and the condemnation of sin does not justify humiliating the person.
seeds_of_logos_en: The Chaplet of Divine Mercy, the litanies, Our Lady's Rosary, and the prayer for perseverance direct listeners toward Christ's cross and resurrection; such devotion has an evangelical meaning when it leads to trust in God, conversion, and love of neighbor.

The image of the Church as a spiritual temple with Christ as the capstone corresponds to the biblical image of the community built on Christ and the apostles; the Church is a communion of living "stones", and not merely an organization or a platform for individual influence.

Distinguishing sin from the sinner, the call to gentleness toward the person, and a public apology for one's own weaknesses can foster humility and reconciliation. Christian conversion does not mean denying sin, but acknowledging it in the light of God's forgiveness and the renewal of human dignity.

The claim that the conversion of a few people is more valuable than a large number of views opposes the culture of measurability and directs attention to the person rather than to popularity. This is fruitful if it does not turn into self-validation of one's own group, but remains linked to service and respect for the dignity of all.

Prayer groups, fasting, and the call to prayer in communion can support perseverance, solidarity, and shared responsibility for the life of the Church. The social teaching of the Church connects faith with love, care for neighbors, and action for the common good, and not only with personal piety.
concerns_en: Contrasting the "Church" and "Satan's anti-church" carries the risk of division into a morally pure in-group and a hostile camp. Spiritual battle against evil should not be equated with demonizing political opponents, other Christian communities, or people who disagree; Christian admonition should preserve truth, justice, and the dignity of the person.

Connecting the fall of a political leader or an electoral message with God's action can suggest a providential certainty that the structure of the podcast itself does not prove. Catholic participation in politics is legitimate and important, but it is judged according to truth, the dignity of the person, and the common good, not according to whether a choice corresponds to the desires of a particular religious group.

"Legitimacy through results" and the question "where are those results?" require a clear demarcation: visible fruits of conversion, communion, and mission are important, but ecclesial authority cannot be reduced to the number of converts, followers, the success of an initiative, or the leader's personal evaluation. The Church is a spiritual temple linked to Christ and the apostolic foundation, not merely a project whose credibility is determined by measurable impact.

"Faith and politics: no room for two kingdoms" can be a healthy assertion that faith must not be shut out of public life, but it would be problematic if it meant equating political power or programs with the Kingdom of God. The Church participates in public life for the sake of truth, justice, and the common good; her political engagement is limited by moral principles and respect for the dignity of all.

Prayers of protection and deliverance can express trust in Christ, but their pastoral effect should not be presented as an automatic guarantee of protection nor replace prudent judgment, sacramental life, and appropriate help in real difficulties. From the structure alone, it is not possible to assess how these prayers are explained or applied.

sections.subtitle: Pozdrav slušateljima i molitva za oslobođenje: vezanje zlih sila u Isusovo ime
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj Vladimir Grebenar pozdravlja gledatelje i započinje molitvu za oslobođenje i zaštitu
sections.content:
Na početku 121. epizode emisije **Oraetlabora Međugorje**, naslovljene „Milosrđe Božje – Kako graditi Hram Božji?“, voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** pozdravlja gledatelje i slušatelje medija Ora et Labora. Odmah najavljuje i središnju misao dana iz evanđelja: Isus je između svojih učenika izabrao dvanaestoricu, koje je prozvao apostolima. Nakon znaka križa, „U ime Oca i Sina i Duha Svetoga“, emisija ne počinje razgovorom. Prvi dio je dugi molitveni blok koji priprema za kasnije tumačenje Božje riječi.

Prva je molitva za oslobođenje i zaštitu. U njoj Grebenar, u ime Isusovo, „uzima vlast“ i veže **sve zle sile i snage**. Pritom nabraja gdje se one mogu nalaziti:

- u zraku,
- na zemlji,
- u vodi,
- u podzemlju,
- na onome svijetu,
- u prirodi,
- u vatri.

Molitva zatim slavi Boga kao Gospodina „nad svim svemirom“, kojemu se daje slava u ime njegova stvorenja. Molitelj veže sve demonske sile koje su došle protiv molitelja i njihovih obitelji. Sve ih stavlja pod zaštitu **Isusove dragocjene krvi**, prolivene na križu.

Slijede tri zaziva:

- **Djevici Mariji** upućuje se molba za zaštitu i zagovor kod Presvetog Srca Isusova za sve obitelji, uz sliku Marijina plašta ljubavi koji „zaogrće“ vjernike „da se prestraši neprijatelj“.
- **Svetom Mihovilu** i **anđelima čuvarima** upućuje se poziv da brane molitelje i njihove obitelji „u borbi protiv svega zla što obilazi svijetom“.
- Na kraju dolazi zapovijed u Isusovo ime: sve sile i snage zla neka „istog časa“ odstupe od molitelja, njihovih domova i njihove zemlje.

Molitva završava zahvalom Isusu „jer si vjeran Bog i osjećaš s nama“.

magisterium.assessment: Molitva se u glavnim nakanama oslanja na katoličku pobožnost: zaziva Božju zaštitu, Kristovu pobjedu nad zlom te Marijin i anđeoski zagovor, što je u skladu s odobrenim katoličkim molitvama. Ipak, izraz da molitelj osobno „uzima vlast” i zapovijeda svim silama zla da odmah odstupe može zamagliti razliku između ponizne molitve za zaštitu i službenog obreda egzorcizma te stvoriti dojam da je takva zapovijed automatski učinkovita.
concerns: Formulacija „uzimam vlast” i izravna zapovijed zlim silama u Isusovo ime zvuče kao eksorcistička naredba. U katoličkoj liturgijskoj modlitvi svetom Mihaelu nalog je usmjeren Bogu — „Neka mu Bog zapovjedi” — a molitvenik također pruža zazive za zaštitu; zato bi bilo primjerenije moliti Boga da zaštiti i oslobodi, a ne predstavljati vlastitu zapovijed kao jamstvo neposrednog učinka.

Nabrajanje zraka, zemlje, vode, podzemlja, onoga svijeta, prirode i vatre može poticati pretjerano prostorno ili magijsko shvaćanje djelovanja zlih duhova. Crkva upozorava da pobožnost prema anđelima ne treba prerasti u sliku neprestane borbe duhovnih sila u kojoj se svakodnevne teškoće pojednostavljeno pripisuju đavlu.

Izraz „da se prestraši neprijatelj” nije sam po sebi protivan nauku, ali lako može usmjeriti naglasak s pouzdanja u Boga na dramatiziranje neprijatelja. Katolička molitva zaštite usmjerava vjernika na Božju pomoć, molitvu i postojanost u dobru.
magisterium.enrichment: Molitva za zaštitu od zla, zazivanje Marijina zagovora i molba svetom Mihaelu i anđelima čuvarima imaju jasno mjesto u katoličkoj pobožnosti; crkvene molitve izričito traže njihovu zaštitu i zagovor. Središte takve pobožnosti ipak je Kristova već izvojevana pobjeda, koju vjernik prihvaća ustrajnom molitvom, budnošću i življenjem evanđelja, a ne strahom ili pretpostavkom da jedna izgovorena zapovijed uklanja svako zlo.

magisterium.assessment_en: In its main intentions, the prayer relies on Catholic devotion: it invokes God's protection, Christ's victory over evil, and Mary's and angelic intercession, which is in accordance with approved Catholic prayers. However, the expression that the person praying personally "takes authority" and commands all forces of evil to depart immediately can blur the distinction between a humble prayer for protection and the official rite of exorcism, and create the impression that such a command is automatically effective.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Prayer for protection from evil, invoking Mary's intercession, and petitioning Saint Michael and the guardian angels have a clear place in Catholic devotion; ecclesial prayers explicitly seek their protection and intercession. The center of such devotion, however, is Christ's already won victory, which the believer accepts through persevering prayer, vigilance, and living the Gospel, rather than through fear or the assumption that a single spoken command removes all evil.
concerns_en: The formulation "I take authority" and the direct command to evil forces in Jesus' name sound like an exorcistic order. In the Catholic liturgical prayer to Saint Michael, the command is directed to God — "May God rebuke him" — and the prayer book also provides invocations for protection; therefore, it would be more appropriate to pray to God to protect and deliver, rather than presenting one's own command as a guarantee of immediate effect.

Enumerating air, earth, water, underworld, the other world, nature, and fire can encourage an overly spatial or magical understanding of the activity of evil spirits. The Church warns that devotion to the angels should not turn into an image of an unceasing battle of spiritual forces in which everyday difficulties are simplistically attributed to the devil.

The expression "so that the enemy may be terrified" is not in itself contrary to teaching, but it can easily shift the emphasis from trust in God to dramatizing the enemy. Catholic prayer of protection directs the believer toward God's help, prayer, and constancy in doing good.

sections.subtitle_en: Greeting to listeners and prayer for deliverance: binding evil forces in Jesus' name
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host Vladimir Grebenar greets viewers and begins the prayer for deliverance and protection
sections.content_en:
At the beginning of the 121st episode of the show **Oraetlabora Međugorje**, titled „Divine Mercy – How to Build the Temple of God?“, host **Vladimir Grebenar** greets the viewers and listeners of the media Ora et Labora. He immediately announces the central thought of the day from the Gospel: Jesus chose twelve from among his disciples, whom he named apostles. After the sign of the cross, „In the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit“, the show does not begin with a conversation. The first part is a long prayer block that prepares for the later interpretation of the Word of God.

The first is a prayer for deliverance and protection. In it, Grebenar, in the name of Jesus, „takes authority“ and binds **all evil powers and forces**. In doing so, he lists where they may be located:

- in the air,
- on the earth,
- in the water,
- in the underworld,
- in the other world,
- in nature,
- in fire.

The prayer then praises God as the Lord „over all the universe“, to whom glory is given in the name of his creation. The intercessor binds all demonic forces that have come against the intercessors and their families. He places them all under the protection of **Jesus' precious blood**, shed on the cross.

Three invocations follow:

- A petition is addressed to the **Virgin Mary** for protection and intercession before the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus for all families, along with the image of Mary's mantle of love that „cloaks“ believers „so that the enemy is frightened“.
- A call is addressed to **Saint Michael** and the **guardian angels** to defend the intercessors and their families „in the battle against all evil that roams the world“.
- At the end comes a command in Jesus' name: let all forces and powers of evil depart „at this very moment“ from the intercessors, their homes, and their land.

The prayer ends with thanks to Jesus „because you are a faithful God and feel with us“.

sections.subtitle: Sveti Mihael arkanđel i molitva za jedinstvo s Isusom
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli molitvu svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu i molitvu za jedinstvo s Isusom
sections.content:
Iza molitve za oslobođenje slijedi **molitva svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu**. Vladimir Grebenar u njoj zaziva arkanđela da brani vjernike „u boju protiv pakosti i zasjeda đavolskih“ i da im bude zaklon. Molitva naziva Mihaela „vojvodom vojske nebeske“ i moli ga da Sotonu i druge zle duhove, „koji svijetom obilaze na propast duša“, „božanskom krjepošću i jakošću u pakao strovali“.

Ton se potom mijenja. S borbenih slika molitva prelazi na nježnu **molitvu za jedinstvo s Isusom**. Molitelj se obraća „ljupkom Isusu“ i moli da se život vjernika potpuno uskladi s njegovim. Slike se nižu jedna za drugom:

- neka noge zajedno hode,
- neka ruke budu skupljene u jedinstvu,
- neka srca kucaju zajedno,
- neka duše budu u skladu, a misli „kao jedno“,
- neka uši zajedno „slušaju tišinu“,
- neka pogledi „duboko prodru jedan u drugi“.

Na kraju dolazi molba da usne zajedno mole kako bi se „zadobilo milosrđe od vječnoga Oca“. Time se prvi put izravno pojavljuje tema **milosrđa**, oko koje je izgrađen cijeli molitveni dio epizode.

magisterium.assessment: Molitva svetom Mihaelu i molba za jedinstvo s Isusom uglavnom su u skladu s katoličkim naukom: Crkva priznaje Mihaelovu zaštitničku ulogu u duhovnoj borbi te kršćanski život shvaća kao sjedinjenje s Kristom. Poetske slike zajedničkih misli, pogleda i koraka mogu se razumjeti kao izraz zajedništva, ali ih ne treba shvatiti kao nestanak osobne slobode i razlika među osobama.
concerns: Izrazi o mislima koje postaju „kao jedno” i pogledima koji „duboko prodru jedan u drugi” mogu biti dvosmisleni ako bi se tumačili doslovno, kao stapanje osoba; u prikazanom kontekstu prikladnije ih je razumjeti kao pjesnički govor o bliskosti i usklađenosti s Kristom.
magisterium.enrichment: Zazivanje svetoga Mihaela kao branitelja od zla odgovara biblijskom prikazu njegove zaštitničke uloge te crkvenom učenju da duhovna borba uključuje molitvu, poniznost i moralno opredjeljenje za Evanđelje, a ne bespomoćnost pred silama zla. Jedinstvo s Isusom valja razumjeti kao život u Kristu i zajedništvo njegova Tijela, a ne kao ukidanje osobnosti; molba za milosrđe vječnoga Oca također je kršćanski primjerena, uz svijest da se sva milost prima od Boga po Kristu.

magisterium.assessment_en: The prayer to Saint Michael and the petition for unity with Jesus are mainly in accordance with Catholic teaching: the Church recognizes Michael's protective role in the spiritual battle and understands Christian life as union with Christ. Poetic images of shared thoughts, gazes, and steps can be understood as an expression of communion, but they should not be understood as the disappearance of personal freedom and distinctions between persons.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Invoking Saint Michael as a defender against evil corresponds to the biblical portrayal of his protective role and to Church teaching that spiritual battle includes prayer, humility, and moral commitment to the Gospel, rather than helplessness before the forces of evil. Unity with Jesus must be understood as life in Christ and the communion of his Body, rather than as the abolition of personality; the petition for the mercy of the eternal Father is also Christians-appropriate, with the awareness that all grace is received from God through Christ.
concerns_en: Expressions about thoughts that become "as one" and gazes that "penetrate deeply into each other" can be ambiguous if interpreted literally, as a merging of persons; in the context presented, it is more appropriate to understand them as poetic speech about closeness and harmony with Christ.

sections.subtitle_en: Saint Michael the Archangel and prayer for unity with Jesus
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host prays the prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel and the prayer for unity with Jesus
sections.content_en:
After the prayer for deliverance follows the **prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel**. In it, Vladimir Grebenar invokes the archangel to defend believers „in battle against the wickedness and snares of the devil“ and to be their safeguard. The prayer calls Michael the „prince of the heavenly host“ and begs him, by the divine power and strength, to „thrust into hell“ Satan and other evil spirits, „who roam through the world for the ruin of souls“.

The tone then changes. From combative images, the prayer moves to a tender **prayer for unity with Jesus**. The intercessor turns to „lovely Jesus“ and prays that the life of believers may be completely harmonized with his. The images follow one after another:

- may our feet walk together,
- may our hands be gathered in unity,
- may our hearts beat together,
- may our souls be in harmony, and thoughts „as one“,
- may our ears together „listen to the silence“,
- may our glances „deeply penetrate one another“.

At the end comes a petition that the lips pray together so that „mercy may be obtained from the eternal Father“. With this, the theme of **mercy** directly appears for the first time, around which the entire prayer portion of the episode is built.

sections.subtitle: Dvostruka posveta: Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu i Presvetom Srcu Isusovu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara posvetu Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu
sections.content:
Sljedeći korak su dvije posvetne molitve. Prva je **posveta Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu**. U njoj se molitelj obraća Presvetoj Djevici Mariji kao „majci i kraljici“ i predaje joj „čitavo svoje biće, svoje misli, riječi i djela“. Daje joj pravo da raspolaže njime i svime što mu pripada, „sada i u vječnosti“. Svrha je posvete:

- hvala i slava Presvetoga Trojstva,
- posvećenje Crkve,
- spasenje svega svijeta.

Molitelj moli i pomoć da živi dostojno svoga **krsnog posvećenja** te da „neopozivo pripada svome Otkupitelju“. Želi, poput Marije, slušati poticaje Duha Svetoga, kako bi se u njemu i u svemu vršila volja Božja.

Druga je **posveta Presvetom Srcu Isusovu**. Ono se u molitvi naziva „izvorom svakoga dobra“. Molitelj mu se klanja, vjeruje u njega, uzda se u njega, ljubi ga i kaje se za sve svoje grijehe. Svoje „siromašno srce“ poklanja Isusu i moli da ga učini poniznim, strpljivim i čistim te da u svemu odgovara Isusovim željama. Molitva završava nizom konkretnih molbi:

- „da ja živim u tebi i ti u meni“,
- zaštita u opasnostima,
- utjeha u nevoljama i žalostima,
- zdravlje tijela,
- blagoslov svega rada,
- milost svete smrti.

Grebenar zatim najavljuje sljedeći dio: Krunicu Božjega milosrđa.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom snažno usklađen s katoličkom pobožnošću: marijansko predanje usmjerava vjernika Kristu, a molitva Presvetom Srcu Isusovu izražava vjeru, pouzdanje, ljubav, kajanje i želju za životom sjedinjenim s njim. Molbe za zaštitu, utjehu, zdravlje i milost svete smrti primjerene su kao prošnje, a ne kao jamstvo da će svaka od njih biti uslišena na željeni način.
concerns: Izraz da Marija raspolaže moliteljem i svime što mu pripada treba razumjeti kao potpuno povjeravanje njezinu zagovoru i majčinskoj skrbi, a ne kao pripisivanje Mariji neovisne vlasti ili božanske uloge; marijansko predanje ostaje usmjereno Bogu po Kristu.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk opisuje posvetu ili predanje Mariji kao pobožnu praksu koja je analogna posveti Bogu, oslanja se na njezin zagovor i treba pomagati vjerniku da vjerno živi krsne obveze; zato je molba da se živi dostojno krsnog posvećenja osobito prikladna. Ivan Pavao II. ističe da predanje Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu u konačnici upućuje na Srce njezina Sina, dok Pio XII. potvrđuje da su pobožnost Srcu Isusovu i pobožnost Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu povezane. Pobožnost Presvetom Srcu Isusovu ima čvrst evanđeoski temelj, a njezin smisao nije samo moliti za pojedinačne darove nego se osloniti na Kristovu ljubav i živjeti u zajedništvu s njim.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is mainly strongly aligned with Catholic devotion: Marian entrustment directs the believer to Christ, and the prayer to the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus expresses faith, trust, love, repentance, and the desire for a life united with him. Petitions for protection, comfort, health, and the grace of a holy death are appropriate as supplications, not as a guarantee that each of them will be granted in the desired manner.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching describes consecration or entrustment to Mary as a pious practice that is analogous to consecration to God, relies on her intercession, and should help the believer faithfully live baptismal commitments; therefore, the petition to live worthily of baptismal consecration is especially fitting. John Paul II points out that entrustment to the Immaculate Heart of Mary ultimately points to the Heart of her Son, while Pius XII confirms that devotion to the Heart of Jesus and devotion to the Immaculate Heart of Mary are connected. Devotion to the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus has a firm evangelical foundation, and its purpose is not only to pray for individual gifts but to rely on Christ's love and live in communion with him.
concerns_en: The expression that Mary disposes of the person praying and everything belonging to them should be understood as complete entrustment to her intercession and maternal care, and not as attributing independent authority or a divine role to Mary; Marian entrustment remains directed toward God through Christ.

sections.subtitle_en: Double consecration: to the Immaculate Heart of Mary and the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host recites the consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
sections.content_en:
The next step is two prayers of consecration. The first is the **consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary**. In it, the intercessor addresses the Blessed Virgin Mary as „mother and queen“ and surrenders to her „his entire being, his thoughts, words, and deeds“. He gives her the right to dispose of him and everything that belongs to him, „now and in eternity“. The purpose of the consecration is:

- praise and glory of the Most Holy Trinity,
- sanctification of the Church,
- salvation of the whole world.

The intercessor also prays for help to live worthy of his **baptismal consecration** and to „belong irrevocably to his Redeemer“. He desires, like Mary, to listen to the promptings of the Holy Spirit, so that in him and in everything the will of God may be done.

The second is the **consecration to the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus**. It is called in the prayer the „source of every good“. The intercessor adores it, believes in it, hopes in it, loves it, and repents for all his sins. He offers his „poor heart“ to Jesus and prays that he make it humble, patient, and pure, and that in everything it correspond to Jesus' desires. The prayer concludes with a series of concrete petitions:

- „that I live in you and you in me“,
- protection in dangers,
- comfort in troubles and sorrows,
- health of the body,
- blessing of all work,
- the grace of a holy death.

Grebenar then announces the next part: the Chaplet of the Divine Mercy.

sections.subtitle: Krunica Božjega milosrđa: „Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli Krunicu Božjega milosrđa i izgovara molitvu „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv…“
sections.content:
Vladimir Grebenar uvodi **Krunicu Božjega milosrđa** kratkim pozivom: „Sklopimo oči, priđimo k milosrdnom Gospodinu.“ Molitva počinje temeljnim molitvama kršćanske tradicije: Očenašem, Zdravomarijom i Apostolskim vjerovanjem. Vjerovanjem molitelji ispovijedaju vjeru u Boga Oca, u Isusa Krista „mučena pod Poncijem Pilatom“ i uskrslog treći dan, u Duha Svetoga, svetu Crkvu katoličku, uskrsnuće tijela i život vječni.

Srce krunice čini pet desetica. Svaka počinje istom molitvom prikazanja:

> „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo preljubljenoga Sina tvojega, Gospodina našega Isusa Krista, kao zadovoljštinu za grijehe naše i cijeloga svijeta.“

Nakon nje dolazi deset ponavljanja zaziva **„Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci, budi milosrdan nama i cijelome svijetu.“** Grebenar ga izgovara ujednačenim, meditativnim ritmom. Ponavljanje stvara molitveno ozračje u kojem se pažnja usredotočuje na Kristovu muku kao izvor milosrđa.

Na kraju se tri puta moli zaziv: „Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože, sveti besmrtni Bože, smiluj se nama i cijelomu svijetu.“ Slijedi molitva krvi i vodi: „O krvi i vodo, što potekoste iz srca Isusova, kao izvor milosrđa za nas, uzdam se u tebe.“ Zaziva se i Marija kao **majka milosrđa**. Krunica završava trostrukim usklikom pouzdanja **„Isuse, uzdam se u tebe“** i molbom „Smiluj se nama i cijelomu svijetu, Gospodine.“

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u skladu s katoličkim naukom: usredotočuje se na Kristovu muku kao izvor Božjega milosrđa, izražava pouzdanje u Isusa i Mariju ispravno naziva Majkom milosrđa. Prikazanje Krista kao zadovoljštine za grijehe primjereno je razumjeti kao molitveno sudjelovanje u jedinoj spasonosnoj žrtvi Krista, a ne kao njezino nadopunjavanje.
magisterium.enrichment: Zaziv krvi i vode upućuje na događaj iz Iv 19,34; u katoličkom tumačenju krv označuje Kristovu žrtvu i euharistijski dar, a voda podsjeća na krštenje i dar Duha Svetoga. Marija se naziva Majkom milosrđa zbog svoje posebne povezanosti s raspetim i uskrsnulim Kristom te sudjelovanja u otkrivanju Božjega milosrđa, ali njezino posredovanje ostaje podređeno Kristu i o njemu ovisno.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is in accordance with Catholic teaching: it focuses on Christ's Passion as the source of God's mercy, expresses trust in Jesus, and correctly names Mary as Mother of Mercy. Offering Christ as reparation for sins is appropriately understood as prayerful participation in Christ's sole salvific sacrifice, not as supplementing it.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The invocation of blood and water points to the event from Jn 19:34; in Catholic interpretation, blood signifies Christ's sacrifice and the Eucharistic gift, and water recalls baptism and the gift of the Holy Spirit. Mary is called Mother of Mercy because of her special connection with the crucified and risen Christ and her participation in revealing God's mercy, but her mediation remains subordinate to Christ and dependent upon him.

sections.subtitle_en: Chaplet of the Divine Mercy: „For the sake of His sorrowful Passion“
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host prays the Chaplet of the Divine Mercy and recites the prayer „Eternal Father, we offer you the Body and Blood…“
sections.content_en:
Vladimir Grebenar introduces the **Chaplet of the Divine Mercy** with a short invitation: „Let us close our eyes, let us approach the merciful Lord.“ The prayer begins with the foundational prayers of the Christian tradition: the Our Father, the Hail Mary, and the Apostles' Creed. Through the Creed, the intercessors profess faith in God the Father, in Jesus Christ „suffered under Pontius Pilate“ and risen on the third day, in the Holy Spirit, the holy Catholic Church, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting.

The heart of the chaplet consists of five decades. Each begins with the same offering prayer:

> „Eternal Father, we offer you the Body and Blood, Soul and Divinity of your dearly beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world.“

After it come ten repetitions of the invocation **„For the sake of His sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world.“** Grebenar recites it in a steady, meditative rhythm. The repetition creates a prayerful atmosphere in which attention is focused on Christ's Passion as the source of mercy.

At the end, the invocation is prayed three times: „Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One, have mercy on us and on the whole world.“ The prayer of the blood and water follows: „O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fount of Mercy for us, I trust in You.“ Mary is also invoked as the **mother of mercy**. The chaplet ends with a threefold exclamation of trust **„Jesus, I trust in You“** and the plea „Have mercy on us and on the whole world, Lord.“

sections.subtitle: Litanije Božjem milosrđu: od stvaranja svijeta do duša u čistilištu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli Litanije Božjem milosrđu uz zaziv „uzdam se u tebe“
sections.content:
Uz Krunicu Božjega milosrđa voditelj moli i **Litanije Božjem milosrđu**. Počinju uobičajenim zazivima: „Gospodine, smiluj se. Kriste, smiluj se“, „Kriste, čuj nas. Kriste, usliši nas“. Zatim se zaziva svaka osoba Presvetoga Trojstva: Oče nebeski, Sine Otkupitelju svijeta i Duše Sveti.

Nakon toga slijedi dugi niz zaziva Božjem milosrđu. Svaki završava istim odgovorom: **„uzdam se u tebe“**. Litanije zapravo opisuju cijelu povijest spasenja kroz prizmu milosrđa. Milosrđe Božje u njima se naziva i opisuje kao:

- „neshvatljiva tajna Presvetoga Trojstva“ i „izraz njegove najveće moći“,
- milosrđe koje se objavilo u stvaranju nebeskih duhova i koje je ljude „iz ništavila pozvalo u život“,
- milosrđe koje obuhvaća čitav svijet i daruje besmrtan život,
- milosrđe koje štiti od zasluženih kazni i oslobađa od bijede grijeha,
- milosrđe koje se izlijeva iz rana Kristovih i izvire iz Presvetoga Srca,
- milosrđe koje je ljudima dalo Presvetu Djevicu za majku milosrđa,
- milosrđe vidljivo u ustanovljenju Crkve i u dijeljenju svetih sakramenata, osobito krštenja, pokore, oltara i svećeništva,
- milosrđe koje se očituje u obraćenju grešnika, posvećenju pravednika i usavršavanju svetih,
- vrelo za bolesnike i patnike, utjeha onih „koji su skršena srca“ i nada onih koji očajavaju,
- „mir umirućih“, zaštita od paklenoga ognja i olakšanje dušama u čistilištu,
- „slast i neizmjerna radost svih svetih“ te „neiscrpiv izvor čudesa“.

Ovi zazivi pokazuju da se Božje milosrđe prema ljudima ne shvaća kao jedan pojedinačni čin. U litanijama ono prati čovjeka od nastanka života, kroz sakramente i patnju, sve do smrti i vječnosti.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u bitnome usklađen s katoličkim naukom: Božje milosrđe prikazuje kao prisutno u stvaranju, Kristovu otkupiteljskom djelu, životu Crkve i nadi vječnoga života. Posebno je prikladno povezivanje milosrđa s obraćenjem i sakramentima, a ne samo s općenitom utjehom.
concerns: Izrazi o zaštiti od zasluženih kazni i od paklenoga ognja ne bi se smjeli razumjeti kao jamstvo da molitva automatski uklanja posljedice grijeha ili osigurava spasenje bez obraćenja i ustrajnosti; opis ih prikazuje kao zazive molitve, pa to nije izričita tvrdnja odlomka.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk drži da se Božje milosrđe ne suprotstavlja njegovoj pravednosti, nego je ne ukida niti zamjenjuje; ono poziva grešnika na obraćenje i daruje oproštenje. Crkva zato osobito upućuje na sakrament pomirenja kao mjesto susreta s milosrđem koje je snažnije od grijeha, dok molitva za pokojne izražava nadu i zagovor za duše u čistilištu.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is essentially aligned with Catholic teaching: it presents God's mercy as present in creation, Christ's redemptive work, the life of the Church, and the hope of eternal life. Connecting mercy with conversion and the sacraments, rather than merely with generalized consolation, is especially appropriate.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching holds that God's mercy is not opposed to his justice, but does not abolish or replace it; it calls the sinner to conversion and grants forgiveness. The Church therefore points especially to the sacrament of reconciliation as the place of encounter with mercy that is stronger than sin, while prayer for the deceased expresses hope and intercession for the souls in purgatory.
concerns_en: Expressions about protection from deserved punishments and from the fire of hell should not be understood as a guarantee that prayer automatically removes the consequences of sin or secures salvation without conversion and perseverance; the description presents them as prayer invocations, so that is not an explicit claim of the passage.

sections.subtitle_en: Litany of the Divine Mercy: from the creation of the world to the souls in purgatory
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host prays the Litany of the Divine Mercy with the invocation „I trust in You“
sections.content_en:
Alongside the Chaplet of the Divine Mercy, the host also prays the **Litany of the Divine Mercy**. It begins with the usual invocations: „Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy“, „Christ, hear us. Christ, graciously hear us“. Then each person of the Most Holy Trinity is invoked: Heavenly Father, Son Redeemer of the world, and Holy Spirit.

After that follows a long series of invocations to the Divine Mercy. Each ends with the same response: **„I trust in You“**. The litany in fact describes the entire history of salvation through the prism of mercy. God's mercy is named and described in them as:

- „incomprehensible mystery of the Most Holy Trinity“ and „expression of its greatest power“,
- mercy that manifested itself in the creation of heavenly spirits and that called human beings „from nothingness into life“,
- mercy that encompasses the whole world and bestows immortal life,
- mercy that shields from deserved punishments and frees from the misery of sin,
- mercy that flows out from the wounds of Christ and springs from the Most Sacred Heart,
- mercy that gave people the Blessed Virgin as the mother of mercy,
- mercy visible in the institution of the Church and in the dispensing of the holy sacraments, especially baptism, penance, the altar, and the priesthood,
- mercy manifested in the conversion of sinners, the sanctification of the righteous, and the perfection of saints,
- a spring for the sick and suffering, solace of those „who are brokenhearted“, and hope of those who despair,
- „peace of the dying“, protection from hellfire, and relief for souls in purgatory,
- „delight and immense joy of all saints“ and an „inexhaustible source of miracles“.

These invocations show that God's mercy toward people is not understood as a single individual act. In the litany, it accompanies man from the beginning of life, through the sacraments and suffering, all the way to death and eternity.

sections.subtitle: Završna molitva: ne očajavati u teškim trenucima
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara završnu molitvu za pouzdanje u Božje milosrđe
sections.content:
Litanije završavaju biblijskom ispoviješću: **„Bog je milosrdan i pun samilosti, spor na srđbu i pun dobrote.“** Na nju se nastavlja obećanje molitelja: „Zato ću dovijeka klicati milosrđu Božjemu.“

Vladimir Grebenar zatim moli završnu molitvu upućenu „vječnom Bogu“. Njegovo je milosrđe „neistraživo“, a „blago smilovanja neiscrpivo“. Molitva traži da Bog milostivo pogleda na molitelje i umnoži u njima svoje milosrđe. Svrha je jasno izrečena: **„da u teškim trenucima ne očajavamo i ne budemo obeshrabreni“**. Umjesto toga, vjernici se žele s velikim pouzdanjem predati Božjoj svetoj volji, „koja je sama ljubav i smilovanje“.

Molitva se zaključuje po Isusu Kristu, kojeg naziva **„kraljem milosrđa“**. Time završava dio posvećen Božjem milosrđu, temi istaknutoj već u naslovu epizode.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u skladu s katoličkim naukom i biblijskim naglaskom na Božjoj milosti: pouzdanje u Božje milosrđe pomaže vjerniku da se u kušnjama ne prepusti očaju, nego se s vjerom povjeri Bogu. Završna molitva Kristu kao „kralju milosrđa” također je u skladu s kršćanskim usmjerenjem molitve po Isusu Kristu.
concerns: Izraz da je Božja volja „sama ljubav i smilovanje” treba razumjeti kao ispovijest pouzdanja u Božju dobrotu, a ne kao tvrdnju da je svako zlo ili patnja sama po sebi izravno htjena od Boga ili da ih treba pasivno prihvatiti bez nastojanja da se uklone.
magisterium.enrichment: Biblijski tekst o Božjem milosrđu prikazuje nadu ne kao poricanje boli, nego kao pouzdanje koje može opstati usred nevolje: Tužaljke govore da Božje milosrđe ne prestaje i da se čovjek može nadati i nakon duboke žalosti. Ivan Pavao II. ističe da poruka Božjeg milosrđa osobito donosi nadu onima koji su pritisnuti kušnjama ili napastovani očajem. Zato predanje Božjoj volji znači povjerenje u Boga i vjernost usred teškoća, a ne uvjerenje da patnja nema težinu niti da je očaj isto što i žalost.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is in accordance with Catholic teaching and the biblical emphasis on God's grace: trust in God's mercy helps the believer not to give in to despair in trials, but to entrust oneself to God with faith. The concluding prayer to Christ as "king of mercy" is also in accordance with the Christian orientation of prayer through Jesus Christ.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The biblical text on God's mercy presents hope not as a denial of pain, but as trust that can endure in the midst of affliction: Lamentations states that God's mercies do not cease and that man can hope even after deep sorrow. John Paul II points out that the message of Divine Mercy especially brings hope to those who are burdened by trials or tempted by despair. Therefore, surrender to God's will means trust in God and fidelity amid difficulties, not a conviction that suffering has no weight or that despair is the same as sorrow.
concerns_en: The expression that God's will is "love and mercy itself" should be understood as a confession of trust in God's goodness, and not as a claim that all evil or suffering is in itself directly willed by God or that it should be passively accepted without efforts to remove it.

sections.subtitle_en: Concluding prayer: not despairing in difficult moments
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host recites the concluding prayer for trust in God's mercy
sections.content_en:
The litany ends with a biblical profession: **„God is merciful and full of compassion, slow to anger and abounding in goodness.“** Following upon it is the intercessor's promise: „Therefore I will forever proclaim God's mercy.“

Vladimir Grebenar then prays the concluding prayer addressed to the „eternal God“. His mercy is „incomprehensible“, and the „treasury of compassion inexhaustible“. The prayer asks that God look kindly upon the intercessors and multiply his mercy in them. The purpose is clearly stated: **„that in difficult moments we might not despair nor become despondent“**. Instead, believers wish to surrender themselves with great confidence to God's holy will, „which is love and mercy itself“.

The prayer is concluded through Jesus Christ, whom he calls the **„king of mercy“**. With this ends the portion dedicated to God's mercy, a theme highlighted already in the title of the episode.

sections.subtitle: Gospina krunica: slavna otajstva uskrsnuća, uzašašća i Duhova
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje Gospinu krunicu i prvo slavno otajstvo – Isusovo uskrsnuće
sections.content:
Nakon molitava milosrđu Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje **Gospinu krunicu** i poziva: „Priđimo Gospodinu i Gospi.“ Moli se **slavna otajstva**, koja razmatraju Kristovu pobjedu nad smrću i Marijinu proslavu.

Svaka desetica ima isti oblik:

- uvodni Očenaš,
- deset Zdravomarija,
- Slava Ocu,
- molitva „O moj Isuse, oprosti nam naše grijehe, očuvaj nas od paklenoga ognja, dovedi u raj sve duše, a osobito one kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe.“

I ova završna molitva svake desetice vraća se temi **milosrđa**, pa se Gospina krunica sadržajno povezuje s prethodnim dijelom.

Otajstva se nižu ovim redom:

1. **Prvo otajstvo** razmatra Isusovo **uskrsnuće** od mrtvih.
2. **Drugo otajstvo**, najavljeno na 00:20:53, posvećeno je Isusu „koji je na nebo uzašao“, odnosno **uzašašću**.
3. **Treća desetica**, s početkom na 00:24:46, razmatra Isusa „koji je Duha Svetoga poslao“, odnosno **silazak Duha Svetoga**.

Grebenar desetice moli mirno i ujednačeno, uz kratke stanke između otajstava. Gledatelji i slušatelji tako mogu moliti zajedno s njim.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u skladu s katoličkim naukom: slavi Kristovo uskrsnuće i uzašašće te silazak Duha Svetoga, a Gospinu krunicu prikazuje kao molitvu razmatranja Kristovih otajstava uz Mariju. Opisani redoslijed i molitveni obrazac ne sadrže očitu teološku poteškoću.
magisterium.enrichment: Uskrsnuće je pobjeda života nad smrću i temelj kršćanske vjere; uzašašće označuje Kristovo proslavljenje uz Oca, a Pedesetnica očituje Crkvu okupljenu s Marijom i osnaženu Duhom za poslanje. Ivan Pavao II. ističe da slavna otajstva vode vjernike nadi u konačni cilj i potiču ih na svjedočenje Evanđelja.

citations.document_title: Rosarium Virginis Mariae on the Most Holy Rosary

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is in accordance with Catholic teaching: it celebrates Christ's resurrection and ascension and the descent of the Holy Spirit, and presents Our Lady's Rosary as a prayer of contemplation of Christ's mysteries alongside Mary. The described sequence and prayer formula do not contain any obvious theological difficulty.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Resurrection is the victory of life over death and the foundation of Christian faith; the Ascension marks Christ's glorification beside the Father, and Pentecost reveals the Church gathered with Mary and empowered by the Spirit for mission. John Paul II emphasizes that the glorious mysteries lead believers to hope in the final goal and encourage them to bear witness to the Gospel.

sections.subtitle_en: Our Lady's Rosary: the glorious mysteries of the Resurrection, Ascension, and Pentecost
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host announces Our Lady's Rosary and the first glorious mystery – Jesus' Resurrection
sections.content_en:
After the prayers to mercy, Vladimir Grebenar announces **Our Lady's Rosary** and invites: „Let us approach the Lord and Our Lady.“ The **glorious mysteries** are prayed, which contemplate Christ's victory over death and Mary's glorification.

Each decade has the same form:

- introductory Our Father,
- ten Hail Marys,
- Glory Be to the Father,
- the prayer „O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, lead all souls to Heaven, especially those most in need of Thy mercy.“

This concluding prayer of each decade also returns to the theme of **mercy**, so Our Lady's Rosary is substantively linked with the preceding part.

The mysteries follow in this order:

1. The **first mystery** contemplates Jesus' **resurrection** from the dead.
2. The **second mystery**, announced at 00:20:53, is dedicated to Jesus „who ascended into heaven“, that is, the **ascension**.
3. The **third decade**, beginning at 00:24:46, contemplates Jesus „who sent the Holy Spirit“, that is, the **descent of the Holy Spirit**.

Grebenar prays the decades calmly and steadily, with short pauses between the mysteries. Viewers and listeners can thus pray along with him.

sections.subtitle: Marijino uznesenje i krunjenje: vrhunac slavnih otajstava
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje peto slavno otajstvo – Marijino krunjenje na nebu
sections.content:
Završna dva slavna otajstva posvećena su Djevici Mariji.

**Četvrto otajstvo** Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje na 00:28:42 riječima koje se odnose na Isusa koji je Djevicu **„na nebo uznio“**. U središtu je razmatranja Marijino uznesenje na nebo. Desetica se moli istim redom kao i prethodne: Očenaš, deset Zdravomarija, Slava Ocu i molitva za oproštenje grijeha i spas duša, „osobito onih kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe“.

**Peto otajstvo**, najavljeno na 00:32:42, razmatra Isusa koji je Djevicu **„na nebu okrunio“**. To je Marijino krunjenje za kraljicu neba i zemlje, završna slika slavnih otajstava.

Ova dva otajstva posljednji put stavljaju Mariju u središte molitve. To je i logičan prijelaz prema završnoj marijanskoj molitvi, kojom se zaokružuje cijeli krunični dio emisije.

magisterium.assessment: Opis Marijina uznesenja tijelom i dušom te njezina proslavljenja kao Kraljice neba u skladu je s katoličkim naukom i s četvrtim i petim slavnim otajstvom. Ipak, tvrdnju da Marija u tim otajstvima dolazi „u središte molitve” valja razumjeti tako da se njezina slava promatra u povezanosti s Kristom, a ne kao da ona zauzima mjesto Krista, središta krunice.
concerns: Izraz „Marija u središtu molitve” može biti neprecizan ako se shvati kao da krunica prestaje biti usredotočena na Krista; bolje je reći da su ova otajstva posebno posvećena Mariji, čija je proslava nerazdvojno povezana s Kristovom pobjedom.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva uči da je Marija, dovršetkom zemaljskog života, uznesena tijelom i dušom u nebesku slavu te od Gospodina uzvišena kao Kraljica; njezino je uznesenje jedinstveno sudjelovanje u uskrsnuću njezina Sina i predznak budućeg uskrsnuća vjernika. Krunjenje zato ne znači da Marija neovisno o Kristu vlada kao božica: njezina je slava primljena od Gospodina i očituje njezinu posebnu suobličenost Sinu. Slavljenje Marije u krunici tako vodi dubljoj nadi u Kristovu slavu i konačnu proslavu Crkve.

citations.document_title: Rosarium Virginis Mariae on the Most Holy Rosary

magisterium.assessment_en: The description of Mary's Assumption body and soul and her glorification as Queen of Heaven is in accordance with Catholic teaching and with the fourth and fifth glorious mysteries. However, the claim that Mary in these mysteries comes "to the center of prayer" must be understood in such a way that her glory is viewed in connection with Christ, and not as though she takes the place of Christ, the center of the Rosary.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church teaches that Mary, upon the completion of her earthly life, was assumed body and soul into heavenly glory and exalted by the Lord as Queen; her Assumption is a unique participation in the resurrection of her Son and an anticipation of the future resurrection of believers. The coronation therefore does not mean that Mary reigns as a goddess independently of Christ: her glory is received from the Lord and manifests her special conformity to the Son. Celebrating Mary in the Rosary thus leads to a deeper hope in Christ's glory and the final glorification of the Church.
concerns_en: The expression "Mary at the center of prayer" can be imprecise if understood as meaning that the Rosary ceases to be centered on Christ; it is better to say that these mysteries are especially dedicated to Mary, whose glorification is inextricably linked to Christ's victory.

sections.subtitle_en: Mary's Assumption and Coronation: the culmination of the glorious mysteries
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host announces the fifth glorious mystery – Mary's Coronation in heaven
sections.content_en:
The final two glorious mysteries are dedicated to the Virgin Mary.

The **fourth mystery** is announced by Vladimir Grebenar at 00:28:42 with words referring to Jesus who **„assumed the Virgin into heaven“**. At the center of the contemplation is Mary's assumption into heaven. The decade is prayed in the same order as the previous ones: Our Father, ten Hail Marys, Glory Be to the Father, and the prayer for the forgiveness of sins and the salvation of souls, „especially those most in need of Thy mercy“.

The **fifth mystery**, announced at 00:32:42, contemplates Jesus who **„crowned the Virgin in heaven“**. That is Mary's coronation as queen of heaven and earth, the final image of the glorious mysteries.

These two mysteries place Mary at the center of prayer for the last time. It is also a logical transition toward the concluding Marian prayer, which rounds off the entire rosary portion of the episode.

sections.subtitle: „Zdravo Kraljice“: vapaj prognanih sinova Evinih
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli zaključnu molitvu „Zdravo Kraljice“
sections.content:
Molitveni dio epizode Vladimir Grebenar zaključuje drevnom marijanskom antifonom **„Zdravo Kraljice“**. Mariju u njoj pozdravlja kao **„majku milosrđa“** te kao „život, slast i ufanje naše“. Naziv „majka milosrđa“ još jednom povezuje kraj molitvenog bloka s njegovom glavnom temom.

Molitva opisuje ljudski život kao progonstvo. Vjernici su „prognani sinovi Evini“ koji k Mariji vape i uzdišu, „tugujući i plačući u ovoj suznoj dolini“. Mariju mole kao zagovornicu da na njih svrne „one svoje milostive oči“ i da im **„poslije ovoga progona“** pokaže Isusa, „blagoslovljeni plod utrobe svoje“.

Molitva završava trostrukim nježnim zazivom: **„o blaga, o mila, o slatka Djevice Marijo“**. Time se zatvara molitveni dio epizode. Slijedi tumačenje Božje riječi iz poslanice Efežanima, koje se nastavlja na najavljeno evanđelje o izboru dvanaestorice apostola.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak vjerno prenosi katoličku molitvu „Zdravo Kraljice“ i izražava dopušteno štovanje Marije kao Majke milosrđa i zagovornice, bez umanjivanja jedinstvene uloge Isusa Krista. Osobito je kristocentričan završetak molitve, u kojem se Mariju moli da nam pokaže Isusa, blagoslovljeni plod svoje utrobe.
magisterium.enrichment: Naziv „Majka milosrđa“ odnosi se na Mariju kao Majku raspetoga i uskrsloga Krista i na njezino posebno sudjelovanje u njegovu poslanju; ne znači da je ona izvor božanskog milosrđa neovisno o Bogu. Katolički nauk također uči da Marija svojim majčinskim zagovorom nastavlja brinuti za Kristove učenike i moliti za njih, dok je Krist onaj komu nas molitva konačno vodi. Slika „suzne doline“ izražava zemaljsko putovanje obilježeno patnjom i nadom u susret s Isusom, što se podudara s objašnjenjem pape Franje o Salve Regini kao molitvi koja traži da nam Marija pomogne motriti Sina kao lice Božjega milosrđa.

citations.document_title: The Shield of Faith: Reflections and Prayers for Wartime
Misericordiae Vultus - Bull of indiction of the Extraordinary Jubilee of Mercy (11 April 2015)

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage faithfully conveys the Catholic prayer "Hail Holy Queen" (Salve Regina) and expresses permissible veneration of Mary as Mother of Mercy and intercessor, without diminishing the unique role of Jesus Christ. The ending of the prayer is particularly Christocentric, in which Mary is asked to show us Jesus, the blessed fruit of her womb.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The title "Mother of Mercy" refers to Mary as the Mother of the crucified and risen Christ and to her special participation in his mission; it does not mean that she is the source of divine mercy independently of God. Catholic teaching also teaches that Mary, through her maternal intercession, continues to care for Christ's disciples and pray for them, while Christ is the one to whom prayer ultimately leads us. The image of the "valley of tears" expresses the earthly journey marked by suffering and hope of encountering Jesus, which coincides with Pope Francis's explanation of the Salve Regina as a prayer asking Mary to help us contemplate the Son as the face of God's mercy.

sections.subtitle_en: „Hail Holy Queen“: the cry of the exiled children of Eve
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host prays the concluding prayer „Hail Holy Queen“
sections.content_en:
The prayer part of the episode is concluded by Vladimir Grebenar with the ancient Marian antiphon **„Hail Holy Queen“**. In it, he greets Mary as **„mother of mercy“** and as „our life, our sweetness, and our hope“. The title „mother of mercy“ once again connects the end of the prayer block with its main theme.

The prayer describes human life as an exile. Believers are „the exiled children of Eve“ who cry and sigh to Mary, „mourning and weeping in this valley of tears“. They pray to Mary as an advocate to turn toward them „her merciful eyes“ and that **„after this exile“** she show them Jesus, „the blessed fruit of her womb“.

The prayer ends with a threefold tender invocation: **„o clement, o loving, o sweet Virgin Mary“**. This closes the prayer portion of the episode. There follows the interpretation of the Word of God from the Epistle to the Ephesians, which continues onto the announced gospel about the choice of the twelve apostles.

iterations.theme_en: Prayer part: prayers of protection and consecration, Chaplet of the Divine Mercy, Litany of the Divine Mercy, and Our Lady's Rosary (glorious mysteries)

sections.subtitle: Sugrađani svetih: crkva kao duhovni hram kojemu je Krist zaglavni kamen
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar započinje tumačenje čitanja iz Poslanice Efežanima
sections.content:
Nakon molitvenog dijela emisije, voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** prelazi na tumačenje svete riječi. Polazište je odlomak iz Poslanice Efežanima: „Braćo, više niste tuđinci ni pridošlice, nego sugrađani ste svetih i ukućani Božji, nazidani na temelju apostola i proroka, a zaglavni je kamen sam Krist Isus.“ U Kristu je, kako stoji u čitanju, sva građevina povezana i raste u hram svet Gospodinu.

Grebenar objašnjava da sveti Pavao ovdje piše o gradnji crkve kao **duhovnog hrama**. U njega pristiže sve veći broj ljudi: pogani koji se obraćaju na kršćanstvo, ali i dio Židova, posebice onih u dijaspori. Ta građevina, naglašava voditelj, nije materijalna nego duhovna. Ona je ono što je u Starom zavjetu bilo predočeno slikom jeruzalemskog hrama, od kojega je do danas ostao samo Zid plača.

„Taj hram, to je čitava crkva, braćo i sestre, crkva Kristova“, sažima Grebenar.

magisterium.assessment: Tumačenje je uglavnom usklađeno s Ef 2,19–22: kršćani su članovi Božjega doma, Crkva je građena na apostolima i prorocima, a Krist je njezin zaglavni kamen i ona raste kao sveti hram. Ipak, izraz da je građevina „duhovna, a ne materijalna” treba pojasniti kako se ne bi stekao dojam da je Crkva samo nevidljiva stvarnost ili da su materijalne crkvene građevine bez značenja.
concerns: Suprotstavljanje duhovnog hrama materijalnom može biti preusko ako se shvati kao isključivanje vidljive i sakramentalne dimenzije Crkve: Katekizam govori o živim kamenovima, a kamene bogomolje naziva simbolima toga hrama.

Tvrdnju da je od jeruzalemskog hrama do danas ostao samo Zid plača valja povijesno precizirati; u ovom odlomku ona nije potrebna za tumačenje Pavlove slike i može zamagliti razliku između hrama kao biblijske ustanove i ostataka njegovih građevinskih sklopova.
magisterium.enrichment: Pavlova slika ne opisuje samo brojčani rast zajednice nego i jedinstvo Židova i pogana u Kristu: Krist povezuje cijelu građevinu, dok su apostoli i proroci temelj na kojem je ona izgrađena. Katekizam dodatno pojašnjava da je Crkva istodobno Božji dom, sveti hram i zajednica živih kamenova, a kamene crkve simboliziraju tu duhovnu stvarnost.

citations.document_author: The New Revised Standard Version, Catholic Edition (NRSV-CE)
The New Revised Standard Version, Catholic Edition (NRSV-CE)

magisterium.assessment_en: The interpretation is mainly aligned with Eph 2:19–22: Christians are members of God's household, the Church is built upon the apostles and prophets, and Christ is its capstone and it grows as a holy temple. However, the expression that the building is "spiritual, not material" should be clarified so as not to give the impression that the Church is only an invisible reality or that material church buildings are without meaning.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Paul's image does not describe merely the numerical growth of the community, but also the unity of Jews and Gentiles in Christ: Christ joins the whole building together, while the apostles and prophets are the foundation on which it is built. The Catechism further clarifies that the Church is simultaneously the household of God, a holy temple, and a community of living stones, and stone churches symbolize that spiritual reality.
concerns_en: Contrasting the spiritual temple with the material one can be too narrow if understood as excluding the visible and sacramental dimension of the Church: the Catechism speaks of living stones, and calls stone houses of worship symbols of that temple.

The claim that of the Jerusalem temple only the Wailing Wall remains today should be historically clarified; in this passage it is not necessary for interpreting Paul's image and may blur the distinction between the temple as a biblical institution and the remains of its architectural complexes.

sections.subtitle_en: Fellow citizens of the saints: the church as a spiritual temple whose cornerstone is Christ
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar begins the interpretation of the reading from the Epistle to the Ephesians
sections.content_en:
After the prayer portion of the show, host **Vladimir Grebenar** transitions to the interpretation of the holy word. The starting point is a passage from the Epistle to the Ephesians: „Brothers, you are no longer strangers and sojourners, but you are fellow citizens with the holy ones and members of the household of God, built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself as the capstone.“ In Christ, as the reading states, the whole structure is held together and grows into a temple sacred in the Lord.

Grebenar explains that Saint Paul writes here about building the church as a **spiritual temple**. An increasing number of people are arriving into it: gentiles who convert to Christianity, but also a portion of Jews, especially those in the diaspora. That structure, the host emphasizes, is not material but spiritual. It is what in the Old Testament was foreshadowed by the image of the Jerusalem temple, of which only the Western Wall remains today.

„That temple, that is the entire church, brothers and sisters, the church of Christ“, Grebenar summarizes.

sections.subtitle: Razjedinjena crkva: nacionalne pravoslavne crkve u službi politike
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj govori o razjedinjenosti crkve i autokefalnim pravoslavnim crkvama
sections.content:
Grebenar zatim postavlja kritično pitanje: što su ljudi učinili od crkve Kristove? U prvim kršćanskim vremenima ona je bila jedinstvena, a danas je razjedinjena. Kao primjer navodi istočnu, pravoslavnu crkvu, koja je i sama podijeljena po načelu **autokefalnosti**. Svaka je pravoslavna crkva, prema njegovu tumačenju, zapravo nacionalna i više u službi neke politike nego obraćanja ljudi.

Tu tvrdnju ilustrira dvjema pravoslavnim crkvama. Prva je ruska, za koju kaže da je u službi Putina. Druga je srpska, kao bliži primjer, za koju tvrdi da je bila u službi Vučića, pri čemu spominje i Porfirija. Uz ironično pitanje koga će sada „pokopati“, Grebenar cijelu situaciju opisuje jednom riječju: „Prestrašno.“

magisterium.assessment: Ispravno je žaliti zbog podjela među kršćanima i upozoriti da se Crkva ne smije podrediti političkoj vlasti, ali tvrdnja da je svaka pravoslavna Crkva nacionalna i u službi politike preširoka je i nije potkrijepljena ponuđenim izvorima. Katolički nauk pravoslavne Crkve priznaje kao istinske partikularne Crkve s apostolskim nasljeđem i valjanom Euharistijom, premda su ranjene zbog nepotpune zajednice s Petrovim nasljednikom.
concerns: Povezivanje autokefalnosti nužno s nacionalizmom ili političkom podložnosti miješa crkveno samoupravljanje s odnosom prema državi; ponuđeni teološki prikaz autokefalnost opisuje kao oblik crkvene autonomije u upravljanju crkvenim poslovima, a ne kao dokaz političke službe.

Tvrdnje da su Ruska pravoslavna Crkva u službi Putina, a Srpska pravoslavna Crkva u službi Vučića, iznesene su kao opće ocjene bez potkrepe u dostupnim izvorima; kritika mogućeg političkog utjecaja trebala bi razlikovati konkretne postupke crkvenih vođa od cijelih Crkava i njihovih vjernika.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko shvaćanje jedinstva Crkve ne znači da su sve kršćanske zajednice izvan punog zajedništva s Rimom bez crkvene stvarnosti: pravoslavne Crkve čuvaju biskupsku hijerarhiju, apostolsko nasljeđe i Euharistiju, ali im nedostaje puno zajedništvo sa Sveopćom Crkvom u zajedništvu s Petrovim nasljednikom. Autokefalnost treba razlikovati od podložnosti državi, jer opis pravoslavne autonomije izričito razlikuje crkvenu upravu od necrkvenih institucija poput države. Stoga je opravdano osuđivati instrumentalizaciju vjere za političke ciljeve, ali takvu prosudbu valja iznositi precizno i bez svođenja cijelih Crkava na političke instrumente.

citations.document_title: Church of Christ, Catholic Church, particular churches, ecclesial communities, 2005, Issue 4, pp. 543–586
Church of Christ, Catholic Church, particular churches, ecclesial communities, 2005, Issue 4, pp. 543–586
The 'Ravenna Document' of the International Joint Catholic-Orthodox Commission, 2008, Issue 4, pp. 541–595

magisterium.assessment_en: It is right to lament divisions among Christians and to warn that the Church must not be subordinated to political authority, but the claim that every Orthodox Church is national and in the service of politics is too broad and is not substantiated by the provided sources. Catholic teaching recognizes the Orthodox Churches as true particular Churches with apostolic succession and a valid Eucharist, although they are wounded due to incomplete communion with the successor of Peter.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic understanding of the unity of the Church does not mean that all Christian communities outside full communion with Rome are without ecclesial reality: Orthodox Churches preserve the episcopal hierarchy, apostolic succession, and the Eucharist, but lack full communion with the Universal Church in communion with the successor of Peter. Autocephaly should be distinguished from subjection to the state, as the description of Orthodox autonomy explicitly distinguishes ecclesial governance from non-ecclesial institutions such as the state. Therefore, it is justified to condemn the instrumentalization of faith for political ends, but such a judgment should be presented precisely and without reducing entire Churches to political instruments.
concerns_en: Connecting autocephaly necessarily with nationalism or political subjection confuses ecclesial self-governance with relations toward the state; the provided theological account describes autocephaly as a form of ecclesial autonomy in governing ecclesial affairs, and not as proof of political servitude.

The claims that the Russian Orthodox Church is in the service of Putin, and the Serbian Orthodox Church in the service of Vučić, are presented as general assessments without support in the available sources; critique of potential political influence should distinguish specific actions of church leaders from entire Churches and their faithful.

sections.subtitle_en: Divided church: national Orthodox churches in the service of politics
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host speaks about the division of the church and autocephalous Orthodox churches
sections.content_en:
Grebenar then poses a critical question: what have people made of the church of Christ? In early Christian times it was unified, and today it is divided. As an example, he cites the eastern, Orthodox Church, which is itself divided according to the principle of **autocephaly**. Every Orthodox church, according to his interpretation, is actually national and more in the service of some politics than of the conversion of people.

He illustrates that claim with two Orthodox churches. The first is the Russian, which he says is in the service of Putin. The second is the Serbian, as a closer example, which he claims was in the service of Vučić, in which connection he also mentions Porfirije. With an ironic question as to whom they will now „bury“, Grebenar describes the whole situation in one word: „Horrible.“

sections.subtitle: Kraj 40-dnevnog posta i pad „ratnog huškača“ s vlasti
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar povezuje završetak posta protiv duhova rata s političkim promjenama u Srbiji
sections.content:
Grebenar ističe podudarnost koju smatra znakovitom. Upravo završava **40-dnevni post protiv rata i duhova rata**, a, kako kaže, „najveći ratni huškač na Balkanu je srušen s vlasti“. Riječ je o osobi koja je, prema njegovim riječima, neizravno prijetila oružjem, uključujući balističke rakete dometa 500 kilometara.

Voditelj prenosi podatak da je na izbore u Srbiji izašlo 70 posto birača. Tu brojku naziva izvanredno i nevjerojatno velikom te dodaje da nitko ne može objasniti što je toliki broj ljudi motiviralo. Tako su, kaže, srušili „diktatora, ratnog huškača“, čovjeka koji je prema njegovim riječima doprinosio ratu još u vrijeme Domovinskog rata u Hrvatskoj, bio sa „radikalom Šešeljem“, održao se na vlasti i širio ratnu mržnju, među ostalim i prema hrvatskom narodu.

Odmah zatim upućuje na Gospine riječi: **„Post može zaustaviti ratove.“** Ipak, Grebenar upozorava na oprez. Europu opisuje kao veliki duhovni vrtlog u kojemu ništa nije gotovo. Ovo je, kaže, tek prva i privremena pobjeda. Pritom se služi sportskom usporedbom: kao u dugom prvenstvu, jedna važna pobjeda još ne znači osvojen naslov. „Ima još mnogo utakmica, jako mnogo“, poručuje on.

magisterium.assessment: Poziv na post i molitvu za mir te oprez da politička pobjeda ne znači konačan mir uglavnom su u skladu s katoličkom duhovnošću. Ipak, povezivanje završetka posta s padom političkog vođe može se shvatiti kao tvrdnja da je post uzrokovao konkretan izborni ishod, a takva uzročnost nije utvrđena niti je treba predstavljati kao zajamčenu.
concerns: Izraz „Post može zaustaviti ratove” može biti pobožan poziv na molitvu i obraćenje, ali bio bi teološki problematičan ako bi značio da post automatski ili mehanički jamči prekid rata ili određeni politički rezultat. Crkveni nauk potvrđuje vrijednost posta i molitve za mir, ali ističe i ljudsku odgovornost te suradnju vjernika; dostupni izvori ne potvrđuju da je post uzrokovao opisani izborni ishod.

Navod pripisan Gospi nije moguće potvrditi iz dostupnih izvora. Ako potječe iz privatne objave, treba ga razlikovati od Svetoga pisma i javne Objave te ga iznositi razborito, a ne kao obvezujući nauk Crkve.

Tvrdnje o izlaznosti, izborima i ulozi imenovanih političkih osoba nisu potkrijepljene dostupnim izvorima pa se ovdje ne mogu provjeriti. Teološki, upozoravanje na ratno huškanje može biti primjereno, ali političke prosudbe treba iznositi odgovorno i bez poistovjećivanja određenog izbornog ishoda s nedvojbenim Božjim djelovanjem.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče post i molitvu za mir: papa Franjo izričito je pozvao na njih kao na odgovor na nasilje, a crkveni dokument o porukama povezanim s Međugorjem govori o važnosti suradnje vjernika i života prema Božjim zapovijedima. To ne uklanja ljudsku odgovornost: mir traži i konkretno djelovanje, poput dijaloga, posredovanja i rada na pravednom rješenju sukoba. Stoga je najuravnoteženije govoriti o postu kao molitvenom sudjelovanju i obraćenju koje može pridonijeti miru, a ne kao dokazivom uzroku političkih događaja ili sigurnom jamstvu da je rat spriječen.

magisterium.assessment_en: The call to fasting and prayer for peace and the caution that a political victory does not mean final peace are mainly aligned with Catholic spirituality. However, linking the end of a fast with the fall of a political leader can be understood as a claim that fasting caused a specific electoral outcome, and such causality is not established nor should it be presented as guaranteed.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages fasting and prayer for peace: Pope Francis explicitly called for them as a response to violence, and the ecclesial document on messages associated with Medjugorje speaks of the importance of the cooperation of believers and living according to God's commandments. This does not remove human responsibility: peace also requires concrete action, such as dialogue, mediation, and work toward a just resolution of conflicts. Therefore, it is most balanced to speak of fasting as prayerful participation and conversion that can contribute to peace, rather than as a provable cause of political events or a sure guarantee that war has been prevented.
concerns_en: The phrase "Fasting can stop wars" may be a pious call to prayer and conversion, but it would be theologically problematic if it meant that fasting automatically or mechanically guarantees the cessation of war or a specific political outcome. Church teaching affirms the value of fasting and prayer for peace, but also emphasizes human responsibility and the cooperation of the faithful; the available sources do not confirm that fasting caused the described electoral outcome.

The quote attributed to Our Lady cannot be confirmed from the available sources. If it originates from private revelation, it must be distinguished from Sacred Scripture and public Revelation and presented prudently, not as binding teaching of the Church.

Claims about turnout, elections, and the role of named political figures are not substantiated by available sources and therefore cannot be verified here. Theologically, warning against warmongering can be appropriate, but political judgments should be made responsibly and without equating a particular electoral outcome with the unmistakable action of God.

sections.subtitle_en: End of 40-day fast and the fall of the „warmonger“ from power
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar connects the completion of the fast against the spirits of war with political changes in Serbia
sections.content_en:
Grebenar highlights a coincidence that he considers significant. The **40-day fast against war and the spirits of war** is just concluding, and, as he says, „the biggest warmonger in the Balkans has been overthrown from power“. This refers to a person who, according to his words, indirectly threatened with weapons, including ballistic missiles with a range of 500 kilometers.

The host reports the data that 70 percent of voters turned out for the elections in Serbia. He calls that figure extraordinarily and unbelievably large and adds that no one can explain what motivated such a number of people. Thus, he says, they overthrew „a dictator, a warmonger“, a man who according to his words contributed to war back during the Homeland War in Croatia, was with the „radical Šešelj“, stayed in power, and spread wartime hatred, among other things toward the Croatian people.

Immediately after that, he points to Our Lady's words: **„Fasting can stop wars.“** Nevertheless, Grebenar warns of caution. He describes Europe as a great spiritual vortex in which nothing is finished. This, he says, is only the first and temporary victory. In doing so, he uses a sports comparison: as in a long championship, one important victory does not yet mean the title is won. „There are still many games, very many“, he conveys.

sections.subtitle: Gospina poruka na dan izbora: mržnja i rat vladaju u srcima ljudi
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj citira posljednju Gospinu poruku i poziva na jaču molitvu
sections.content:
Govoreći o tome kako se gradi crkva, Grebenar se poziva na posljednju Gospinu poruku i naziva je „vrlo znakovitom“. Podsjeća da zajednica Ora et Labora, koja potječe iz Međugorja, okuplja desetke tisuća ljudi u molitvi i tisuće u postu te upravo završava 40-dnevni post protiv duhova rata.

Poruka je, kako navodi, stigla prije dva-tri dana i poklopila se s danom izbora u Srbiji, 25. u mjesecu. U njoj Gospa poziva na **još jaču molitvu** i upozorava da mržnja i rat vladaju u srcima ljudi. „To je tako točno. To vidimo po Europi sada“, komentira Grebenar. Njegovo je tumačenje sljedeće: da bi se dogodio veliki rat, mora postojati mnogo ljudi koji rat nose u srcu. Kad se posti i moli, odstupaju „duhovi nacionalizma i rata“.

Zato ponavlja da nikakva pobjeda nije izvojevana i da su pred vjernicima duge bitke do konca. Poziva se pritom na Isusove riječi: „Tko ustraje do kraja, taj će se spasiti.“

magisterium.assessment: Poziv na molitvu, post, odbacivanje mržnje i ustrajnost u vjeri uglavnom je u skladu s katoličkim naukom; Crkva izričito upozorava na pogubnost mržnje i pretjeranog nacionalizma. Ipak, tvrdnja da post i molitva uzrokuju povlačenje „duhova nacionalizma i rata” te da je za veliki rat nužno da ga mnogi nose u srcu izrečena je kao siguran uzročno-posljedični zaključak, što nadilazi ono što se može utvrditi iz navedenih izvora.
concerns: Prikaz privatne marijanske poruke kao potvrđene činjenice ne bi smio sugerirati da ona ima istu obvezatnost ili autoritet kao Sveto pismo i nauk Crkve.

Povezivanje posta s povlačenjem „duhova nacionalizma i rata” može biti duhovno slikovito, ali bez dodatnog pojašnjenja riskira prikazati ga kao zajamčeni mehanizam koji uklanja rat ili njegov duhovni uzrok.
Tvrdnja da veliki rat zahtijeva velik broj ljudi koji ga nose u srcu pojednostavljuje uzroke rata i nije potkrijepljena navedenim biblijskim ili crkvenim izvorima.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni izvori podupiru molitvu, post i obraćenje kao odgovor na grijeh, mržnju i rat; Ivan Pavao II. posebno upozorava da pretjerani nacionalizam može voditi nasilju i osveti, ali razlikuje takav nacionalizam od legitimne ljubavi prema domovini. Isusove riječi o ustrajnosti do svršetka poziv su na vjernost kroz kušnje, a ne obećanje da će molitva ili post sami po sebi spriječiti određeni rat.
