magisterium.assessment_en: The call to voluntary giving, gratitude to donors, conversion and praise of Jesus, and testimony of healing are mainly compatible with the Catholic faith. However, the description of the purpose of the donations remains vague, and personal testimony of healing does not in itself confirm either a medical cause or a miracle.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Giving for ecclesial and apostolic action can be a concrete expression of gratitude to God and Christian generosity, but its purpose and management should be sufficiently clear and directed toward real needs and service to others. Testimony of healing can foster gratitude and hope: in the New Testament, healings are linked with Jesus' mission and the proclamation of the Gospel, but Catholic prayer for the sick goes together with responsible care for their physical health.
concerns_en: The expression that the standing order is opened "for the Lord, not for us" can emphasize the spiritual intention of giving, but it should not obscure who receives and manages the funds; the description does not state concretely how the money is used. Ecclesial criteria require that donations be prudently directed toward real needs and apostolic mission, avoiding self-referentiality.

The emphasis on the needs of the Croatian people is not in itself contrary to faith, but becomes problematic if ecclesial affiliation is equated with national affiliation or if the Christian mission is reduced to a national goal. This passage does not explicitly make such a claim, so it is a matter of potential ambiguity rather than an established deviation.

The witness's claim that the Lord helped him can be accepted as a personal experience of faith, but from it one cannot conclude that doctors were unnecessary or that the cure is proven to be miraculous. Catholic teaching explicitly states that prayer for healing does not exclude the use of effective natural means and medical care.

sections.subtitle_en: Standing order „for the Lord“ and a testimony of healing
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar thanks donors and reads a testimony of healing
sections.content_en:
Grebenar invites listeners to become members of the patriotic initiative Ora et Labora. Registration is filled out via a form on the website. For those who have difficulties with the internet, mobile phone numbers are displayed, including those for Bosnia and Herzegovina, which they can contact for help.

He thanks donors and conveys an anecdote from a promotion. A woman told him that she set up a standing order, and he answered her that she set it up **„for the Lord, not for us, least of all for me“**. The funds, he explains, are directed toward what is important for the Croatian people. They are intended for the „remnant that has faith“ and those who want to be part of the church Saint Paul writes about, who want to convert and grow in faith. He calls for continued support with an „open hand and an open heart“.

Then he reads a short testimony from a female or male listener: „Praise and glory to Jesus. He healed me of severe pain in the bladder. Terrible problems. Doctors could not help at all. The Lord healed me. I can again lift my children without fear.“ The testimony ends with a prayer that all of Croatia praise and love Jesus.

sections.subtitle: Krunica na trgu i molitvene skupine: „Vas dvoje-troje, ali gdje jeste“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj poziva na molitvu krunice u Zagrebu i najavlja centar Kraljica Mira
sections.content:
Pred kraj emisije Grebenar poziva na molitvu krunice na trgu u **Zagrebu**. Poziv je upućen i Hrvatima u Njemačkoj i Austriji, za koje se organizira prijevoz, a brojevi mobitela prikazani su na ekranu.

Istodobno potiče slušatelje da molitvu pokrenu u vlastitom mjestu, putem WhatsApp grupe, pa makar ih bilo samo dvoje ili troje. Podsjeća na prethodni dan, kada je tumačio prispodobu o gorušičinu zrnu: gdje su dvojica ili trojica u Isusovo ime, ondje je i Bog i to će narasti. „Dat će Bog da naraste, pa će to biti nešto veliko u hrvatskom narodu, veliko za svijet. Već sad jest“, poručuje on.

Emisiju zaključuje blagoslovom: „Neka se sveta Mati sa svojim Sinom i svetim Josipom udostoji blagoslov svoj nam dati.“ Na kraju podsjeća da se kupnjom njegove prve, druge i treće knjige pomaže završetak, kako kaže, privatnog projekta za Gospodina. Riječ je o **Međunarodnom edukacijskom centru Kraljica Mira**, koji opisuje kao mjesto za evangelizaciju i nastavak gradnje crkve. Oproštaj s gledateljima glasi: „Neka je sve na veću slavu Božju.“

magisterium.assessment: Poticanje zajedničke krunice, molitvenih skupina i evangelizacije uglavnom je u skladu s katoličkim naukom: Crkva cijeni zajedničku molitvu krunice, a Isus obećava svoju prisutnost okupljenima u njegovo ime. Ipak, povezivanje obećanja iz Mt 18,20 s prispodobom o gorušičinu zrnu i očekivanjem da će pokret sigurno narasti može zamagliti značenje tih zasebnih biblijskih tekstova.
concerns: Mt 18,20 govori o Isusovoj prisutnosti među onima koji su okupljeni u njegovo ime; sam po sebi ne obećava da će njihova skupina brojčano ili društveno narasti. Tvrdnju da će molitva „narasti“ trebalo bi stoga razumjeti kao nadu i molitvenu želju, a ne kao zajamčen ishod.

Izraz da će Marija, njezin Sin i sveti Josip dati blagoslov može se razumjeti kao pobožan zaziv njihova zagovora. Bilo bi korisno jasnije naznačiti da blagoslov u konačnici dolazi od Boga, a da se Marija i sveci zazivaju kao zagovornici.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potvrđuje zajednički karakter krunice i povezuje njezino moljenje s nastojanjem da molitva i život budu usklađeni; krunica također može služiti kao sredstvo evangelizacije i dubljeg upoznavanja Krista. Isusovo obećanje da je prisutan među dvojicom ili trojicom okupljenima u njegovo ime ohrabruje i male skupine, ali ih smješta u šire poslanje Crkve, a ne jamči određeni uspjeh.

magisterium.assessment_en: Encouraging the communal Rosary, prayer groups, and evangelization is mainly in accordance with Catholic teaching: the Church values the communal prayer of the Rosary, and Jesus promises his presence to those gathered in his name. However, linking the promise of Mt 18:20 with the parable of the mustard seed and the expectation that the movement will surely grow can blur the meaning of these distinct biblical texts.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church affirms the communal character of the Rosary and connects its praying with the effort to harmonize prayer and life; the Rosary can also serve as a means of evangelization and deeper knowledge of Christ. Jesus' promise that he is present where two or three are gathered in his name encourages even small groups, but places them within the broader mission of the Church, rather than guaranteeing a specific success.
concerns_en: Mt 18:20 speaks of Jesus' presence among those gathered in his name; in itself it does not promise that their group will grow numerically or socially. The claim that the prayer will "grow" should therefore be understood as a hope and prayerful desire, rather than a guaranteed outcome.

The expression that Mary, her Son, and Saint Joseph will give a blessing can be understood as a pious invocation of their intercession. It would be useful to indicate more clearly that blessing ultimately comes from God, and that Mary and the saints are invoked as intercessors.

sections.subtitle_en: Rosary in the square and prayer groups: „Two or three of you, but right where you are“
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host invites to the rosary prayer in Zagreb and announces Queen of Peace center
sections.content_en:
Toward the end of the show, Grebenar invites to the rosary prayer in the square in **Zagreb**. The invitation is also extended to Croats in Germany and Austria, for whom transportation is organized, and mobile phone numbers are displayed on the screen.

At the same time, he encourages listeners to launch prayer in their own locality, via a WhatsApp group, even if there are only two or three of them. He recalls the previous day, when he interpreted the parable of the mustard seed: where two or three are in Jesus' name, there God is also and that will grow. „God will grant that it grows, and it will be something great in the Croatian nation, great for the world. It already is right now“, he conveys.

He concludes the show with a blessing: „May the holy Mother with her Son and Saint Joseph deign to grant us their blessing.“ At the end, he reminds that buying his first, second, and third books helps complete, as he says, a private project for the Lord. It concerns the **Queen of Peace International Educational Center**, which he describes as a place for evangelization and the continued building of the church. The farewell to viewers is: „May all be to the greater glory of God.“
